description: List the most recently tabled early day motions (EDMs) in the House of Commons: title, primary sponsor, date, and the supporter count Parliament reports. Useful for campaigners, charities and unions watching what MPs are backing. Source: UK Parliament Oral Questions and Motions API. For full text and the list of signatories use early_day_motion_detail. (cost: 1 credit)

take.description: int, optional, number of motions 1-100, default 20

name: early_day_motions_recent
